text: The clinic is extremely clean and the tools/materials used are new and highly up to date. The doctors and nurses are highly professional and excellent at their jobs.
Clean and beautifully designed facility with professional dentists. It’s conveniently located right next to Coffee Bean, making it easy to grab a meal after dental treatment.

I had such a good experience at Odontologia. The clinic feels bright, super clean, and very modern as soon as you walk in. Everyone there was friendly, and the specialists took time to explain things in a way that was easy to understand.

I decided to do my Invisalign here, and what really impressed me was the digital scan that showed a preview of how my teeth would look after treatment. It made me feel much more confident and excited to start. I felt well looked after the whole time.

Definitely recommend this place to anyone thinking about braces or Invisalign.
Odontologia is the best dental clinic. I am super satisfied with the service I received.

To be honest, I came because of the renowned dentists. Each of them is highly skilled in their own field and always in high demand. Upon arrival, I was impressed by the scent and the beautiful, fragrant atmosphere. Inside the room, it was even better. The equipment is modern, and the chair I usually lie on is hard, but this one was so comfortable; I could just lean my weight on it. Importantly, today I came for a tartar removal and a spa treatment for my teeth and gums. It was the first time I felt like every tooth and every angle was being treated. The dentists were incredibly skilled; it wasn't painful at all, and their touch was gentle. Finally, they finished with polishing powder. Normally, when you get polished, it feels like you're scratching your car or polishing your shoes, but this time, I realized they were actually polishing! The dentist explained that they use premium powder, which is very fine, but you don't feel the swirling motion of any polishing machine. In short, I loved it and highly recommend it.

I really enjoy getting my teeth cleaned and tartar removed here. The dentist is very gentle and polishes my teeth thoroughly, finishing with an airflow cleaning step.
🌟 The airflow is amazing; it's a technique for meticulously cleaning between teeth using water and salt.
